summary: Connects to an MQTT broker to subscribe, publish, log, and callback on topic messages for IoT, sensor, control, and network messaging workflows.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable the MQTT client connection

key_params.name: netaddress
key_params.note: Broker host or network address

key_params.name: specifyid
key_params.note: Enable a custom MQTT client identifier

key_params.name: usercid
key_params.note: Client identifier used when Specify ID is on

key_params.name: keepalive
key_params.note: Maximum idle time in seconds before sending broker ping messages

key_params.name: maxinflight
key_params.note: Maximum number of MQTT messages in flight at once

key_params.name: cleansession
key_params.note: Control whether the broker preserves client session state for the specified ID

key_params.name: verifycert
key_params.note: Verify broker TLS certificates for ssl or wss connections

key_params.name: username
key_params.note: Broker authentication username

key_params.name: password
key_params.note: Broker authentication password

key_params.name: reconnect
key_params.note: Automatically reconnect after connection loss

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT for connection, loss, and published-data events

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose where callback scripts execute from

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator context used when Execute From is set to Specified Operator

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Limit FIFO output to a bounded number of messages

key_params.name: maxlines
key_params.note: Maximum retained message rows when Clamp Output is on

key_params.name: clear
key_params.note: Clear all logged rows except the heading

key_params.name: bytes
key_params.note: Output raw message bytes in a separate column

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language selection

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: An MQTT broker is required; this DAT is a client, not a broker/server.
Clean session and custom client ID settings affect whether broker subscriptions and queued messages persist.
TLS certificate verification can fail against self-signed brokers unless configured deliberately.
Pending message limits and callbacks matter for bursty sensor topics or unreliable networks.
key_concepts: Connects to an MQTT broker and logs MQTT client events/messages in a DAT.
Network address, client id, keepalive, max inflight, and clean session define connection behavior.
Certificate verification and username/password parameters handle broker authentication.
Reconnect, callbacks, and FIFO retention controls manage live message handling.
